items.title: Hackers activate automatic defrosting in supermarket fridges across Europe
'Unprecedented' Cyberattack cripples supermarket fridges across Europe as hackers activate automatic defrosting  — delivery and store prices also impacted by incident

brief: Tuesday, October 13's snapshot has a throughline — Hackers activate automatic defrosting in supermarket fridges across Europe, which turned up on hackernews, lemmy at once. Builders spent the day on morluto/rea. On Steam, Counter-Strike 2 drew the biggest crowd.
